name: Zofia Kowalczyk
bio:
Zofia's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through a family steeped in racing lore, but through a fascination with precision engineering. After graduating top of her class from the Warsaw University of Technology with a degree in mechanical engineering, she spent several years honing her skills at a local manufacturing plant, becoming intimately familiar with the intricacies of metalwork and machining. However, the repetitive nature of the work left her yearning for a more dynamic and challenging environment.

She transitioned to motorsport after answering an advertisement for a machinist at a small rally team. Her meticulous approach and ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical issues quickly impressed her colleagues. Zofia is a staunch believer in preventative maintenance and rigorous testing, often pushing for more comprehensive inspections than strictly required. Her colleagues know her for her relentless pursuit of perfection, often spending extra hours ensuring every component meets her exacting standards. While technically gifted, she sometimes struggles with delegation, preferring to handle intricate tasks herself to guarantee the highest level of precision. She joined the ART Grand Prix Academy five years ago and has become an invaluable member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical bun
physical.description: Zofia is of average height, with a sturdy build reflecting years spent working with heavy machinery.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with technical drawings and calculations.
Has a habit of humming quietly while working, often Polish folk tunes.
Insists on cleaning her tools meticulously at the end of each day, regardless of how busy she is.
